# `anim-graph` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "anim-graph" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/anim-graph/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Rig id, e.g. "greybox-humanoid"; clips name it as their rig. |
| `notes` | string | required | What the rig is for, for owner review. |
| `skeleton` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Bones, parents before children; the first is the root. |
| `skeleton[].bone` | id | required | Bone name, unique in the skeleton, e.g. "upper-arm-l". |
| `skeleton[].parent` | id or null | required | Parent bone (listed earlier), or null for the root; exactly one root. |
| `skeleton[].offset` | list of any (at least 3) | required | Rest position relative to the parent, metres ([x, y, z]; +y up, −z forward). |
| `skeleton[].shape` | object | — | Grey-box placeholder shape drawn for the bone; absent = invisible. |
| `skeleton[].shape.size` | list of any (at least 3) | required | Box size, metres. |
| `skeleton[].shape.center` | list of any (at least 3) | `[0,0,0]` | Box centre relative to the bone, metres. |
| `masks` | map of id → list of id (at least 1) | `{}` | Named bone sets for masked layers, e.g. { "upper-body": ["spine", …] }. |
| `layers` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Layers, bottom first: base locomotion, then masked actions, then additive reactions. |
| `layers[].id` | id | required | Layer id, e.g. "base", "action", "hit". |
| `layers[].mode` | `"override"` \| `"additive"` | `"override"` | override replaces lower layers (by mask); additive adds its rotations on top. |
| `layers[].mask` | id | — | Bone mask (a key of `masks`) the layer affects; absent = every bone. |
| `layers[].initial` | id | required | State the layer starts in. |
| `layers[].states` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The layer’s states. |
| `layers[].states[].id` | id | required | State id, unique in its layer (the probe reports it), e.g. "idle". |
| `layers[].states[].motion` | object | required | What the state plays: { kind: "clip", clip }, { kind: "blend1d", param, points }, { kind: "blend2d", x, y, points }, { kind: "action", fallback } (the sim’s running move, time-warped to its frame data) or { kind: "none" } (the layer contributes nothing). |
| `layers[].states[].motion.kind` | `"clip"` | required |  |
| `layers[].states[].motion.clip` | ref → anim-clip | required | Clip id (the clip manifest, content type anim-clip). |
| `layers[].states[].motion.kind` | `"blend1d"` | required |  |
| `layers[].states[].motion.param` | `"speed"` \| `"turnRate"` \| `"grounded"` \| `"acting"` \| `"actionPhase"` \| `"actionVerb"` \| `"hitReact"` \| `"hitReaction"` \| `"hitDirection"` | required | Number parameter the blend follows, e.g. "speed". |
| `layers[].states[].motion.points` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Clips by parameter value, ascending; weights are linear between neighbours. |
| `layers[].states[].motion.points[].at` | number | required | Parameter value at which this clip has full weight. |
| `layers[].states[].motion.points[].clip` | ref → anim-clip | required | Clip id. |
| `layers[].states[].motion.kind` | `"blend2d"` | required |  |
| `layers[].states[].motion.x` | `"speed"` \| `"turnRate"` \| `"grounded"` \| `"acting"` \| `"actionPhase"` \| `"actionVerb"` \| `"hitReact"` \| `"hitReaction"` \| `"hitDirection"` | required | Number parameter on the x axis, e.g. "speed". |
| `layers[].states[].motion.y` | `"speed"` \| `"turnRate"` \| `"grounded"` \| `"acting"` \| `"actionPhase"` \| `"actionVerb"` \| `"hitReact"` \| `"hitReaction"` \| `"hitDirection"` | required | Number parameter on the y axis, e.g. "turnRate". |
| `layers[].states[].motion.points` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Clips by [x, y]; weights are inverse-distance, exact on a point. |
| `layers[].states[].motion.points[].at` | list of any (at least 2) | required | [x, y] parameter values at which this clip has full weight. |
| `layers[].states[].motion.kind` | `"action"` | required |  |
| `layers[].states[].motion.fallback` | ref → anim-clip | required | Clip played when the running move’s presentation.anim is not a clip of this rig. |
| `layers[].states[].motion.kind` | `"none"` | required |  |
| `layers[].transitions` | list of object | `[]` | Transitions, tried in order; the first whose `from` and `when` match is taken. |
| `layers[].transitions[].from` | string | required | Source state id, or "*" for any state other than `to`. |
| `layers[].transitions[].to` | id | required | Target state id. |
| `layers[].transitions[].duration` | number 0–5 | `0.2` | Crossfade duration, seconds. |
| `layers[].transitions[].when` | list of object | `[]` | Conditions on sim parameters, all of which must hold; empty = always. |
| `layers[].transitions[].when[].param` | `"speed"` \| `"turnRate"` \| `"grounded"` \| `"acting"` \| `"actionPhase"` \| `"actionVerb"` \| `"hitReact"` \| `"hitReaction"` \| `"hitDirection"` | required | A sim-published parameter (ANIM_PARAMETERS). |
| `layers[].transitions[].when[].op` | `"=="` \| `"!="` \| `"<"` \| `"<="` \| `">"` \| `">="` | required | Comparison; flags and strings allow == and != only. |
| `layers[].transitions[].when[].value` | number or boolean or string | required | Value compared against; must match the parameter’s kind. |
